Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Shared Kemenag Kota Mojokerto organization workspace coordinating authorized hall booking devices.

name.description: Display name of the organization workspace (3 to 100 characters).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who initialized the workspace.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of authorized staff Firebase Auth UIDs (1 to 100 entries).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

WorkspaceMember.title: WorkspaceMember
WorkspaceMember.description: Verified staff membership record unlocked with the organization password.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified staff member.

accessHash.description: Salted SHA-256 verification digest proving knowledge of the app access password.

displayName.description: Optional staff display name from Google profile (up to 100 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at join.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Hall reservation record synchronized in real time across authorized devices.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the staff member who created the booking.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of authorized workspace member UIDs permitted to read and manage this booking.

namaPeminjam.description: Borrower or organization name (3 to 100 characters).

tanggalEpochMs.description: Local midnight epoch timestamp in milliseconds for date and weekly filtering.

durasiPinjam.description: Booking duration display string (e.g., 4 Jam or 1 Hari).

noWhatsapp.description: Borrower WhatsApp phone number (9 to 20 characters).

catatan.description: Optional notes or event equipment requirements (up to 500 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Organization workspace storing authorized staff member UIDs.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/members/{membe.description: Per-user verified membership documents under the workspace.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Real-time shared hall booking records scoped to authorized workspace members.
